description_en: The three-bayed Kumārī Pāṭī is located at Bungamati Bus Park. It was commissioned in 1724 CE by a certain Gomatī and her three sons in memory of her husband. In 2003 CE, the three-bayed traditional structure was demolished and reconstructed 15 centimetres wider than the original. The wooden posts were replaced with concrete columns clad in traditional brick (dāciaḥpā) and the roof was covered with traditional roof tiles (jhĩgaṭī).  In 2018, the bays were enclosed with iron grills. In the same year, a small wooden shrine of Kṛṣṇa was installed and a group of senior residents began using the space regularly to chantbhajanas. The Kumari from Bungamati visits the Kumārī Pāṭī for certain important festivals such as the Bungadhya procession.During the reconstruction work in 2003, an inscription from the Licchāvi period was found in the surrounding area and placed at the left corner of the Pāṭī. It is, however, not related to the monument.Bungmati 1968: a Survey by Danish Architect Students(p. 11, fig. 15) contains a historical photo showing Kumārī Pāṭī.
description_ne: यो पाटीको निर्माण नेसं ८४४ मा बुङ्गमतीका गोमती र उनका तीन छोराले दिवंगत बुबाको (गोमतीका पति) नाममा गरेका हुन् । तीन कवलको परम्परागत शैलीमा बनेको पाटीBungmati 1968 A Survey by Danish Architect Studentsपुस्तकमा प्रकाशित फोटोको पृष्ठभूमिमा देख्न सकिन्छ (पृष्ठ ११ ) । सन् २००३ मा परम्परागत शैलीको पाटीलाई कंक्रिटको प्रयोग गरी पुनःनिर्माण गरिएको हो । बाह्र वर्षमा एकपटक बुङ्गद्यःको नयाँ रथ बनाई बुङ्गमतीबाट रथजात्रा सुरु र अन्त हुने परम्परा छ । रथ बुङ्गमतीबाट पाटनतर्फ लैजादै गर्दा बुङ्गमती कुमारीलाई यस पाटीमा विराजित गराइन्छ । त्यसै गरी पाटी अगाडि भोटो जात्रा हुने समयमा पनि कुमारीलाई यसै पाटीमा राखिन्छ ।पाटीको दक्षिणपूर्वी कुनामा एक लिच्छविकालीन अभिलेख खडा गरिएको छ । यो अभिलेखको फल्चासँग कुनै सम्बन्ध छैन । धनबज्रले यो अभिलेखलाई बुङ्गमतीको कुनै पोखरीको किनारामा देखेको कुरा उल्लेख गरेका छन् (Vajrācārya, VS 2030, 290) । पछि मात्र यसलाई यहाँ ल्याइएको बुझिन्छ । लिच्छविकालीन सामाजिक, सांस्कृतिक, आर्थिक र राजनैतिक इतिहास अध्ययनमा यो अभिलेखको ठुलो महत्त्व रहेको छ । कैलाशकूट भवनको पहिलो उल्लेख परेको अभिलेख यही नै हो । त्यसै गरी मानदेवको पालादेखि प्रयोग हुँदै आएको शक संवत्‌को साटो अर्कै संवत्‌को उल्लेख परेको पहिलो अभिलेख पनि यही नै हो । यस अभिलेखमा राजाले कृषकहरूको प्रोत्साहनका निम्ति कर छुट गरेको प्रसङ्ग छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Together with her three sons, Gomatī commissioned this Pāṭī in memory of her husband.

Kumārī Pāṭī was reconstructed with the help of the Rotary Club Lalitpur and the local residents, who together donated a sum of 550,000 NRS. The inauguration day was the 31st of Jyeṣṭha 2060 VS. Before the reconstruction, the building was severely dilapidated and had collapsed in places. A concrete structure which imitates traditional carving forms was selected as the replacement. 16 years later, some of the local residents have expressed a wish that the building included more traditional elements (such as wood carvings) so as to give it more traditional look.
Abhajanachanting committee was formed by the local senior citizens.

historical_events.event_name: Licchavi King Aṃśu Varman issued a decree
historical_events.event_description: This Licchavi inscription echoes a decree issued by King Aṃśu Varman. It stands at the south-eastern corner of the Pāṭī, though there is no historical relationship between the inscription and the Pāṭī. D.Vajrācārya(VS 2030, 290) mentions that he once saw this inscription somewhere far away from this site, at the banks of a pond in Bungmati. He notes that it later disappeared from there.
